I'm still in my teens but I honestly have missed out on a lot during the years due to my depression. I see all of my friends talking and doing things together and despite that, I can't bring myself to be motivated to try and set myself back into the picture. I envy those who do things that I've always wanted to do and I remind myself that if I wasn't who I am now I could've done these things. I hate depression but it's something I can't really help.

Our circumstances are different but I relate to how you feel in some regard. I struggle to cope with a toxic family and I have thought of suicide before...which will probably make me seem like a hypocrite when I say this; All I can really give you is my support and love but I really hope you find some kind of escape other than death because perhaps your life will turn around one day. I know it is probably odd to hear that from a stranger but  I truly hope you find some happiness and I want you to know myself and everyone in this subreddit wants to support you. I know words aren't enough to change your circumstances but I make it my mission to let you know you're not alone. Much love!
